legenda: Eles entraram na vila abandonada e descobriram que a saída exige um preço terrível. Apenas dois podem voltar para casa vivos. 😱 Qual amigo do seu grupo você sacrificaria para escapar? Comente aqui embaixo! #terror #vilafantasma #suspense #misterio
falas: Three friends crossed into the forbidden ghost village, unaware that the rusted gate would permanently lock behind them.
Inside the empty houses, warm food was smoking on dining tables, but not a single living soul was there.
Maya touched a shattered mirror in the chapel, and three distorted reflections stared right back at her.
Heavy church bells began chiming frantically through the thick fog, yet the bell tower was completely destroyed.
Shadowy figures suddenly appeared at every broken window, perfectly mimicking each panicked movement the three explorers made.
Leo tried forcing the village exit, but their own freshly carved names were already etched into ancient stone graves.
A phantom voice whispered only two could leave. If you were trapped, which friend would you sacrifice to escape?
